_comment: Predefined playbook actions per ARCHITECTURE.md §4. Mirrors backend/services/playbook_engine.py's ACTION_RISK_TABLE exactly, kept as data here (not code) so a non-engineer teammate could review/tune it during Judge Simulation prep without touching Python.

actions.label: Quarantine suspicious email
actions.description: Moves the message out of the recipient's inbox into a quarantine folder. Fully reversible, no data loss — safe to auto-execute.

actions.label: Block sender domain
actions.description: Adds the sender's domain to an org-wide blocklist for a cooldown period. Reversible by an admin at any time — safe to auto-execute.

actions.label: Isolate endpoint from network
actions.description: Cuts network access for a single flagged device while leaving it otherwise operational. Reversible in seconds — safe to auto-execute.

actions.label: Flag media as unverified
actions.description: Adds a visible 'unverified' banner/tag to the content wherever it's referenced. Purely informational, no destructive effect — safe to auto-execute.

actions.label: Notify security team
actions.description: Sends an internal notification to the analyst team. No external effect at all — always safe to auto-execute.

actions.label: Suspend user account
actions.description: Locks a real employee out of their account. High business-disruption risk if the alert is a false positive — ALWAYS requires human approval.

actions.label: Freeze pending wire transfer
actions.description: Halts a real financial transaction. Directly affects money movement and vendor/employee trust if wrong — ALWAYS requires human approval.

actions.label: Revoke signing credential
actions.description: Permanently invalidates a signing credential (see revocation_registry.py). Hard to reverse quickly — ALWAYS requires human approval.

actions.label: Force password reset (all sessions)
actions.description: Logs the user out everywhere and forces a new password. Major disruption if the login anomaly turns out to be legitimate travel — ALWAYS requires human approval.

actions.label: Escalate to legal/compliance
actions.description: Formally opens a legal/compliance review. Has real organizational and reputational consequences — ALWAYS requires human approval.
